html:
The Rookhollow Tunnel event is the first Community Project of the Kapirosian Communal Charity. Two mining guilds are digging a tunnel between Rookborne Basin and the Rokhala Mountains, and you help one of them by completing quests. The guild that gets the most volunteer work done wins a unique reward from the charity.

Pick your side wisely
This is a competition between the two guilds. The reward goes to the guild with the most volunteer work done, which is not limited to daily quest completions.

Getting started

The Kapirosian Communal Charity has moved into the Altar of Hata in Swirling Meadow. Its followers worship Kapiros, the capybara that roams the ring road around the altar.

  1. Talk to Kapitan Priest Bruntwick at the Altar of Hata, who is asking for volunteers.
  2. Pick a mining guild and talk to its representative at the altar.
  3. Take the quest from the representative and head to the tunnel to work.

Kapitan Priest Bruntwick at the Altar of Hata in Swirling Meadow.

The two guilds

Both guilds offer a stipend of Kapi's Koins to volunteers who contribute. The guilds come from Haranya and Nuia.

Royster's Excavation CompanyWest side
Works on the west side of the tunnel in Rookborne Basin.
  • Representative: Royster's Excavation Representative at the Altar of Hata
  • Camp foreman: Foreman Shortleg Stunty
Glitterstone Miner's GuildEast side
Works on the east side of the tunnel in the Rokhala Mountains.
  • Representative: Glitterstone Guild Representative at the Altar of Hata
  • Camp foreman: Foreman Rockbreaker Rocky
  • Royster's Excavation Representative
  • Glitterstone Guild Representative

Quests

Both guilds have matching quests. The quest names and screenshots below are from the Glitterstone Miner's Guild, and the Royster's Excavation Company equivalents work the same way.

Report to the foreman

The representative sends you to the foreman of your guild's camp. Completing the quest rewards a Kapi's Koin.

Clearing the Rookhollow Tunnel (daily)

The daily quest is Clearing the Rookhollow Tunnel. Craft a Blast Mining Explosive at a Blast Mining Assembly Table and use it to blast a Rookhollow Tunnel Boulder on your guild's side of the tunnel.

  • Craft Blast Mining Explosive 0/1
  • XP: 27,512
  • Coins: 37 28
  • Kapi's Koin

Blast Mining Explosive

The explosive is a trade pack made at the Blast Mining Assembly Table.

  • Required labor: 50
  • Workbench: Blast Mining Assembly Table
  • Materials: 5 x Lumber and 12 x Gunpowder
  • Cost: 3

Camps and locations

The camps sit at the two ends of the tunnel. The marker on each map shows the Rookhollow Tunnel.

  • Royster's Excavation Company camp
  • Royster's camp in Rookborne Basin (southeast side)
  • Glitterstone Miner's Guild camp
  • Glitterstone camp in the Rokhala Mountains (west side)

See also

  • Official announcement
